newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to host South Africa investment conference.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to host South Africa investment conference.

text.p: U.S. and South African government and business officials will get together next week to discuss trade and investment opportunities in South Africa, the U.S. Commerce Department said Thursday.
The conference in Washington on Monday and Tuesday will group representatives from about 200 U.S. businesses, 35 South African companies and several government agencies from the two countries.

"It gives an opportunity for the private sector to get together and not only network, which is important in the business world, but also talk about their common problems," U.S. Secretary of Commerce William Daley told reporters.
He said it would also give government officials a chance to hear concerns of companies interested in doing business in South Africa.

South African Trade Minister Alec Erwin is expected to speak to the conference, sponsored by the Commerce Department, Overseas Private Investment Corporation, the U.S. Trade and Development Agency and the U.S. Export-Import Bank.
